mapper.select:
select info.api_intf_id as openIntfId, info.api_intf_name as openIntfName, info.api_intf_code as openIntfCode from api_intf_info info where 1 = 1
and info.api_intf_code in (SELECT b.api_intf_code FROM sys_auth_register_api a LEFT JOIN sys_auth_register_func_api b ON a.id = b.register_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{model.tenantId} AND b.delete_flag = '1')
order by api_intf_code
select info.sdk_intf_id as openIntfId, info.sdk_intf_name as openIntfName, info.sdk_intf_code as openIntfCode from sdk_manage_info info order by sdk_intf_code

select info.api_intf_id as openIntfId, info.api_intf_name as openIntfName, info.api_intf_code as openIntfCode, info.call_route, info.is_open, info.api_intf_type, info.open_privilege, info.creator, info.create_time, info.modifier, info.update_time from api_intf_info info
info.api_intf_id = #{openIntfId}

select info.sdk_intf_id as openIntfId, info.sdk_intf_name as openIntfName, info.sdk_intf_code as openIntfCode, info.call_route, info.creator, info.create_time, info.modifier, info.update_time from sdk_manage_info info
info.sdk_intf_id = #{openIntfId}

select info.intf_id as intfId, info.api_intf_id as openIntfId, info.request_url as requestUrl, info.request_type as requestType, info.consumer as consumer, info.server as provider, info.server_code as serviceCode, info.server_name as serviceName, info.request_example as requestExample, info.response_example as responseExample, info.intf_describe as serviceDesc, info.create_staff as createStaff , info.create_time as createTime, info.update_staff as updateStaff, info.update_time as updateTime from api_intf_extend_info info
info.api_intf_id = #{openIntfId}

select info.sdk_intf_id as openIntfId, info.request_url as requestUrl, info.request_type as requestType, info.consumer as consumer, info.provider as provider, info.service_code as serviceCode, info.service_name as serviceName, info.request_example as requestExample, info.response_example as responseExample, info.service_desc as serviceDesc from SDK_INTF_INFO info
info.sdk_intf_id = #{openIntfId}

select info.sdk_intf_id as openIntfId, info.field_desc as fieldDesc, info.field_name as fieldName, info.field_type as fieldType, info.field_remark as fieldRemark, info.content_example as contentExample, info.required as required, info.sort as sort, info.type as type from SDK_INTF_REQ_INFO info
info.sdk_intf_id = #{openIntfId}

select info.param_id as paramId, info.api_intf_id as openIntfId, info.param_describe as fieldDesc, info.paran_name as fieldName, info.param_type as fieldType, info.content_example as contentExample, info.param_explain as fieldRemark, info.is_null as required, info.sort as sort, info.request_param_type as type from api_request_param info
info.api_intf_id = #{openIntfId}
